svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Return to the executive summary: the notebook preserves occurrences, the evidence ledger preserves disagreement and lineage, and the pinned calculator runs only when the explicit pair qualifies. The practical result is a private local memory/revision slice exercised by a real Hive caller, with duplicate-safe evidence and recovery across independent commits. It is not yet an autonomous reasoning loop or production deployment. All required M2 gates passed; fixtures, real providers, historical blocked source reproduction and unrun extensions retain their labels. The work stops at M2.
svg.text: Each state owner commits its part. Each retry keeps its meaning.
Real Hive · real local DeTTa · actual guarded PLN revision
